name: assignment
trans: n. a duty that you are assigned to perform (especially in the armed forces)

name: case study
trans: n. a careful study of some social unit (as a corporation or division within a corporation) that attempts to determine what factors led to its success or failure

name: dissertation
trans: n. a treatise advancing a new point of view resulting from research; usually a requirement for an advanced academic degree

name: focus
trans: n. the concentration of attention or energy on something; maximum clarity or distinctness of an image rendered by an optical system
v. direct one's attention on something; cause to converge on or toward a central point

name: aim
trans: n. an anticipated outcome that is intended or that guides your planned actions; the goal intended to be attained (and which is believed to be attainable)
v. point or cause to go (blows, weapons, or objects such as photographic equipment) towards; propose or intend

name: purpose
trans: n. an anticipated outcome that is intended or that guides your planned actions; what something is used for

name: target
trans: n. a reference point to shoot at; a person who is the aim of an attack (especially a victim of ridicule or exploitation) by some hostile person or influence
v. intend (something) to move towards a certain goal

name: article
trans: n. nonfictional prose forming an independent part of a publication; one of a class of artifacts

name: editorial
trans: n. an article giving opinions or perspectives

name: interview
trans: n. the questioning of a person (or a conversation in which information is elicited); often conducted by journalists; a conference (usually with someone important)
v. conduct an interview in television, newspaper, and radio reporting; discuss formally with (somebody) for the purpose of an evaluation

name: questionnaire
trans: n. a form containing a set of questions; submitted to people to gain statistical information

name: fact
trans: n. a piece of information about circumstances that exist or events that have occurred

name: statistic
trans: n. a datum that can be represented numerically

name: data
trans: n. a collection of facts from which conclusions may be drawn

name: chart
trans: n. a visual display of information; a map designed to assist navigation by air or sea

name: table
trans: n. a set of data arranged in rows and columns; a piece of furniture having a smooth flat top that is usually supported by one or more vertical legs

name: trend
trans: n. a general direction in which something tends to move; general line of orientation

name: regularity
trans: n. a property of polygons: the property of having equal sides and equal angles; the quality of being characterized by a fixed principle or rate

name: section
trans: n. a self-contained part of a larger composition (written or musical)

name: catalogue
trans: n. a complete list of things; usually arranged systematically

name: headline
trans: n. the heading or caption of a newspaper article

name: bibliography
trans: n. a list of writings with time and place of publication (such as the writings of a single author or the works referred to in preparing a document etc.)
